mapper.select: SELECT DATE(COALESCE(group_create_time, create_time)) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wx_group_chat WHERE corp_id = #{corpId} AND del_flag = 0 AND (dismiss_flag = 0 OR dismiss_flag IS NULL) AND COALESCE(group_create_time, create_time) >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(group_create_time, create_time))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS chatTotal, COALESCE(SUM(member_num), 0) AS memberTotal FROM wx_group_chat WHERE corp_id = #{corpId} AND del_flag = 0 AND (dismiss_flag = 0 OR dismiss_flag IS NULL)
SELECT user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM wx_customer WHERE corp_id = #{corpId} AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id != '' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
